The '''MG7 proton torpedo launcher''' was a model of [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] manufactured by [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]].

==Description==
The MG7 [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] had a magazine of three [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]], usually loaded with [[MG7-A proton torpedo/Legends|MG7-A proton torpedoes]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] were outfitted with a pair of MG7s, one on either side of the fuselage, giving the fighter a total [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] capacity of six torpedoes.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] fired [[Proton torpedo/Legends|Proton torpedoes]] from an MG7 launcher during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] that destroyed the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="EGWT" />
